jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARTA HEALTH

 

In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non-clinical operations. Charta is changing that.

 

We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

 

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead the development of our platform, the infrastructure, APIs, and self-serve tooling that let us turn complex, bespoke customer builds into scalable, repeatable product. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of platform architecture, customer insights, and go-to-market. You'll work closely with software engineers, forward deployed software engineers, sales, and customers, translating complex, bespoke customer needs into repeatable, self-serve platform capabilities that drive our growth engine.

You will lead platform strategy across customer verticals, building the infrastructure, standards, and self-serve tooling needed to scale our offering efficiently and predictably. This role is the connective tissue between bespoke customer builds and core platform capabilities, identifying opportunities to productize common integration and workflow patterns and deliver leverage across teams, rather than letting customization accumulate as one-off work.

This is a high-trust, high-impact role on a team that thrives on ownership. You'll be translating patterns across customer clusters into durable platform capabilities, unlocking roadmap efficiency and reducing delivery time for future customers.

What you'll do

 - Own the platform and infrastructure roadmap underpinning our core business units

 - Own the lifecycle of key platform initiatives from inception to launch, including internal tooling that helps engineering build, ship, and deploy more consistently

 - Gather technical requirements from strategic customer deployments to inform what gets built into the platform versus what stays bespoke

 - Define business models, pricing packages, and commercial standards for platform and API-driven offerings

 - Make build-vs-buy and build-vs-partner calls on infrastructure and integrations

 - Help steer the growth of our product and engineering organization as platform needs scale

What we're looking for

 - 5–8+ years in product management, forward deployed engineering, or a hybrid customer-facing technical role, ideally with real ownership of platform, API, or integrations work

 - Proven ability to translate customer complexity into modular, scalable platform solutions rather than repeated bespoke builds

 - Experience building platform or infrastructure products with GTM alignment (pricing, packaging, strategy)

 - Strong technical fluency, allowing for deep collaboration with engineers on architecture, system tradeoffs, and building scalable infrastructure

 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills to align stakeholders across functions

 - Bias for action and ownership; thrives in ambiguity and can drive clarity through structured thinking

 


YOU’D BE A GREAT FIT, IF YOU:

 

 - Turn ambiguity into clarity. You translate customer signals and workflows into clear product direction that balances user needs and technical constraints

 - See patterns in the noise. You cut through scattered customer feedback, regulatory shifts and and market signals to prioritize product features

 - Build cross-functional trust. You communicate clearly across teams and navigate technical and strategic discussions with confidence

 - Drive alignment with precision. You break down complex inputs into actionable product specs that keep engineering, deployment, and leadership on the same page

 - Want to build from zero to one. As our first PM, you’ll shape how we scale across verticals, streamline onboarding, and define the future of our product

 - Understand how things fit together. You’re fluent in technical tradeoffs, configuration design, and how infrastructure maps to user value

 


WHAT WE OFFER:




 - Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, and more

 - Team dinners and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Growth opportunities in a fast-paced, innovative tech startup

 - Ongoing professional development and access to cutting-edge AI and healthcare tools

 - Wellness & learning stipends so you can invest in both your health and personal growth

 - Lively in-person (required 5 days per week) work culture at our headquarters in downtown San Francisco

 - $250,000 - $300,000 USD depending on experience + equity + benefits

 - Annual performance based bonus up to 30%

 

At Charta, we believe great products begin with great people, and nowhere is that more true than in this role. You’ll be trusted with our most valuable relationships, and given the autonomy and tools to succeed. If you’re excited about healthcare, software, and making complex systems work for people, we’d love to meet you!


OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARTA HEALTH

 

In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non-clinical operations. Charta is changing that.

 

We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Operational Excellence: Own and continually evolve the "operating system" for our engineering org — the cadences, tooling, and sources of truth (Linear, program reviews) that keep work legible across every pod.

 - Strategic Execution: Define and drive the execution framework for high-stakes technical roadmaps, giving teams the context to make decentralized decisions without slowing down.

 - Orchestration: Manage the technical roadmap from early-stage discovery to full-scale deployment, coordinating the launch of new AI capabilities across the platform.

 - Customer Delivery: Support the operating layer of customer implementations across multiple concurrent accounts — track delivery health across pods, help scope engineering work so it maps cleanly to delivery expectations, and surface at-risk go-lives before they slip.

 - Program Support: Help stand up the cross-functional programs that keep delivery healthy — evaluation, onboarding, quality — and keep them running.

 - Communication & Context: Act as the source of truth for program health. Translate complex technical and clinical status into actionable updates that give both leadership and individual contributors clarity.




YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Professional Background: 4+ years in technical program management or engineering operations, ideally within high-growth technology environments.

 - Tech-Fluency: You don't need a CS degree, but you have deep experience working alongside software engineers. You're comfortable navigating technical environments — APIs, development workflows, data pipelines, and AI/ML-driven systems — well enough to keep projects aligned and ask the right questions.

 - Domain Adaptability: You don't need a healthcare background, but you're energized by learning a regulated, high-stakes domain — clinical documentation, medical coding, payer rules — deeply enough to spot when something looks wrong before it ships.

 - Delivery & Operational Instinct: You've run delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams and can feel when one is about to slip before it's officially off-track.

 - Radical Candor: You give and receive direct, honest feedback with senior leadership and engineering peers to keep initiatives on track.

 - Judgment & Ownership: You thrive in ambiguity, make high-quality decisions quickly, and take full accountability for outcomes.

 - Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority across pods and give leadership a clear read on program health.




WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision.

 - Equity & growth opportunities in a fast-growing, innovative tech startup.

 - Ongoing professional development and access to cutting-edge AI and healthcare tools.

 - Lively, in-person work culture at our SF Headquarters.

 - $120,000 – $160,000 USD depending on experience + Equity + Benefits.

 - Annual performance-based bonus up to 30%.




OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARTA HEALTH

 

In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non-clinical operations. Charta is changing that.

 

We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own platform capabilities end to end, both the external abstractions customers build on and the internal tooling our own engineering team relies on to build and ship.

This is an execution-focused role for a senior PM who wants to own both the direction and the day-to-day work of turning bespoke, one-off work into durable, reusable platform.

You'll work closely with software engineers, deployment strategists, sales, and customers. You'll be the PM on the ground, setting direction for platform and integrations and then making it real: defining requirements, prioritizing ruthlessly, and partnering with deployment so that what we build for one customer becomes leverage for the next, rather than a one-off build that has to be repeated.

This role lives or dies on judgment: knowing which problems to solve once at the platform level and scale, and which to leave as one-off customizations. It takes someone who gets ahead of where the platform needs to go, owns the architecture-level tradeoffs, and cares enough to get the details right. That person is you.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

We have a product motion that's working. The next phase is scale, and that's where this role lives: building the platform, APIs, and internal tooling that take us from a handful of customers to hundreds, then thousands, without a linear increase in engineering and deployment effort.

 - Own our platform and integrations roadmap from requirements through launch and iteration

 - Deeply understand the technical landscape we're integrating into: the legacy systems, data formats, and workflows our customers already run on

 - Build the map to get us there, and drive engineering toward it

 - Build the right abstractions and APIs so the product scales cleanly to hundreds and eventually thousands of customers, instead of bespoke work piling up

 - Partner daily with engineering and deployment strategists to turn each customer's custom build into durable, reusable platform capability

 - Evaluate build-vs-buy and build-vs-partner tradeoffs for internal tooling and infrastructure, not just customer-facing features

 - Turn integration and scalability patterns into clear, prioritized specs

 - Define and maintain the technical standards that keep engineering, deployment, and leadership aligned

 - Make sharp prioritization calls between platform investment and one-off customer needs, and keep the team focused on the right things


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–8 years in product management, ideally with real ownership of platform, API, or integrations work, not just feature or growth product

 - A track record of shipping, owning platform or infrastructure work and driving it to outcomes, not just strategy decks

 - Proven ability to translate customer complexity into modular, reusable systems rather than repeated bespoke builds

 - Strong technical fluency to collaborate deeply with engineers on real architecture and system tradeoffs

 - Comfort operating in a genuinely fast-moving, ambiguous environment, ideally with prior exposure to a company scaling quickly

 - Clear communication and the judgment to prioritize well under ambiguity

 - Bias for action and ownership; thrives in ambiguity and drives clarity through structured thinking


YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU

 - Do the work. You're energized by the day-to-day craft of product, not just the vision.

 - Turn ambiguity into clarity. You translate customer signals into clear direction and prioritize what matters.

 - Build systems. You think in systems and abstractions, not one-offs, and design for leverage that scales across customers and teams.

 - Partner well. You navigate technical and strategic discussions across engineering, deployment, and GTM with confidence.

 - Team dinners and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

 - Growth opportunities in a fast-paced, innovative tech startup

 - Ongoing professional development and access to cutting-edge AI and healthcare tools

 - Wellness & learning stipends so you can invest in both your health and personal growth

 - Lively in-person (required 5 days per week) work culture at our headquarters in downtown San Francisco or in our NYC office

 - $200,000 - $250,000 depending on experience + equity + benefits

 - Annual performance based bonus up to 30%

 

At Charta, we believe great products begin with great people. You'll be trusted with real ownership and given the autonomy and tools to succeed. If you're excited about healthcare, software, and making complex systems work for people, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CHARTA HEALTH

 

In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non-clinical operations. Charta is changing that.

 

We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up.


About the role



We're not looking for a traditional PMM who produces one-off assets. We're looking for a go-to-market strategist: someone who acts as the headlights for the business, helping direct where we go and why, while working across the entire funnel from TOFU to BOFU to help drive the revenue number.

You'll drive the strategy for our core business unit, becoming the most knowledgeable person in the company about our buyers: who they are, what motivates them, and where they live online and offline. That expertise is what shapes and accelerates everything downstream, including how campaigns get built, how sales sells, and how product prioritizes. You're not executing against requests from those teams. You're the one shaping what they do.



What you'll own:

 1. Audience expertise. Know your buyers better than anyone else in the org, including AEs. Understand their motivations, objections, and the language that actually lands.

 2. Strategy. Serve as the "headlights" for your business unit: tell demand gen what's timely and worth building a campaign around, tell sales how to talk to buyers, tell product what the market is telling you.

 3. Pipeline. You carry the pipeline number for your business unit. It overlaps with the campaign strategist's goal and the field marketer's event goal, so wins compound across the team.

 4. Sales enablement. Build the collateral, decks, and messaging that turn AEs into consultants, not transactional reps.

 5. Internal alignment. Be the go-to voice on how the rest of the org should speak to your audience.



You’re a good fit if you:

 - Have 4+ years in product marketing, ideally at a high-growth B2B startup

 - Want to be evaluated on a number, a real business outcome, not just tactical output

 - Run toward ambiguity. We hire for ownership, not for people who wait on direction.

 - Excited to meet buyers live. You're the one working the booth, having real conversations that actually shape how we sell.

 - Great at communicating visually and verbally. You have a gift for making the complicated feel obvious.


OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
